title: Reimagining the World Through WOC Speculative Fiction
description: Explores how women, queer, non-binary and trans folks of colour respond to the world as it has been, is and should be. Focuses on the speculative work of African and Asian North American authors in diaspora who have thought beyond climate and cultural apocalypse. Employs film, critical essays, short stories, poems, podcasts and novels.
